notes: Distinctive full name (Mamidi Pranith Ram), so no ambiguity risk. Verified on five criteria: (1) Yashoda Hospitals' OWN official doctor page, whose URL path encodes the branch and department exactly as the input row states - /doctor/secunderabad/nephrology/dr-mamidi-pranith-ram/ - titled 'Dr. Mamidi Pranith Ram | Best Nephrologist in Hyderabad', describing him as Nephrologist and Renal Transplant Physician at Yashoda Hospital Secunderabad with 13+ years and publishing his OPD hours; (2) his own official professional website drpranithramnephro.com, which independently states he is Nephrology Consultant at Yashoda Hospitals, Hyderabad. Name + specialty (nephrology AND renal transplant, exactly the input row's wording) + hospital + branch (Secunderabad) + city + experience (13-14 years) all match. BAND REASONING, so a reviewer can second-guess it: I count two independent official sources - the hospital's own site and the doctor's own professional website (section 3 Tier 2 classes an 'official personal or clinic website' as official professional presence). He also appears on three further Yashoda pages (nephrology doctors list, kidney transplant doctors list, Secunderabad doctors list) but those are the SAME domain and add no independence. If a reviewer counts only hospital / government / academic domains as official, this row should be read as Medium; nothing else about it changes. No government (healinindia.gov.in) listing exists - I checked and he is not there. No ORCID, Google Scholar or ResearchGate surfaced. NUMBERS I FOUND AND DELIBERATELY DID NOT RECORD: (a) a JustDial listing 'Dr. Pranith Ram (Yashoda Hospital) in Patni Nagar, Secunderabad' - JustDial publishes call-tracking proxy numbers, which are barred; (b) '+91 7042937687', which a search summary attached to his name but which actually traces to a curofy.com listing (headed 'Dr. Pranith Ram, NEW DELHI'), is a mobile-series number, and could not be attributed to any indexed official page - recording it would have been fabrication by association; (c) a Scribd document titled 'DOCTORS Mobile Numbers List' surfaced on the query and was ignored entirely as a scraped personal-mobile dump. The Curofy 'NEW DELHI' city label is almost certainly an aggregator artefact from his AIIMS New Delhi training years and is not evidence of a Delhi practice. medcarereach.com markets him as 'Best Kidney Specialist in Siddipet' - third-party marketing, not evidence of a Siddipet clinic, so owns_clinic remains false. The Facebook page recorded is his own professional page ('Dr Pranith Ram Nephrologist | Hyderabad'), not a hospital account.
